basic_details.job_title: BBMB Lineman Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Candidates who have passed 10th class with at least 40% marks and hold a National Trade Certificate in the Lineman trade can apply for 7 seats of one-year Lineman apprenticeship training with the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB), Construction Division, Dhulkote (Ambala), for session 2026-27, under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. Applications are accepted online only, through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026. Selection is on a merit list of 10th and ITI marks, with no written exam and no interview.

how_to_apply: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online.
Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked):
ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT)
important_instructions: Candidates who, after finishing their education, have done apprenticeship training or are doing it now in any other establishment under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 should not apply. Candidates who are already registered and have trained under these schemes will not be considered and need not apply. Selection and deployment of apprentices depend on the detailed provisions of the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments, if any. The competent authority will decide the place of training based on administrative needs and the candidate's suitability for the area under Construction Division, BBMB, Dhulkote. Requests for a specific place of posting are generally not considered. The result of the apprentice engagement will be uploaded on the BBMB websites through the office of the System Software Manager, BBMB, Chandigarh. Office contact: Addl. Superintending Engineer, Construction Division, BBMB Dhulkote (Ambala City) 134007; Email: [email protected]; Telefax: 0171-2541524.

content_sections.heading: About BBMB
content_sections.text: Bhakra Beas Management Board (Power Wing) describes itself on its letterhead as a statutory body under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. These apprenticeship seats are under its Construction Division, headed by the Addl. Superintending Engineer at Dhulkote (Ambala City) 134007.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the following eligibility for ITI Trade Apprentices (Lineman): The candidate must have passed the 10th class examination with at least 40% marks from a recognised Board, and must also hold a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training/State Council for Vocational Training in that trade. The candidate must have completed the relevant ITI course. The candidate must have an Aadhaar Card. It is compulsory and is needed for online registration. Age: as per the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Reservation: as per the Apprentice Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Candidates whose results for the qualifying examinations are still awaited on the last date for receipt of applications will not be considered. For the full eligibility for the Lineman trade, see the official notification and the BBMB website. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The seats are for a one-year apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 for session 2026-27. The stipend amount is not specified in the notice. The notice says the stipend details are on the BBMB website (bbmb.gov.in). The contracts of the selected candidates will be registered under the NAPS Portal. The notice also says that contracts for the 7 Lineman Apprentice seats will be issued as and when a vacancy arises, on the basis of the merit list. That merit list is valid up to 28.02.2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Lineman
content_sections.text: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online. Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked): 10th Mark sheet ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable) Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: There is no interview and no written exam. Eligible candidates will be selected from the database of the apprenticeship portal (NAPS/NATS). Selection is based on a merit list prepared for all applicants, using the percentage of marks in matriculation (10th) and the ITI course: 25% of the seats available for each trade will be given to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the concerned districts of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If any of these reserved seats remain unfilled, they will go to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If seats still remain unfilled, they will be filled through open merit. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate gets preference. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is considered first.

rows.weightage: 30% to 10th class, 70% to ITI in concerned trade

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 07 seats for Lineman trade apprentices under Construction Division, BBMB, Dhulkote (Ambala) for 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BBMB Lineman apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The Receipt of applications clause says applications will be received online from 05.11.2026 to 03.12.2026. The advertisement's first paragraph gives 07/12/2026 as the closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the BBMB Lineman apprenticeship?
faq.answer: You need to have passed 10th class with at least 40% marks from a recognised Board. You also need a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade from NCVT/SCVT and to have completed the relevant ITI course.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BBMB Lineman apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the BBMB Lineman apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through the NAPS portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), from 5 November 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted, and an Aadhaar Card is compulsory for registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the BBMB apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection is on a merit list. For ITI apprentices, the 10th marks carry 30% weightage and the ITI marks in the concerned trade carry 70%, out of a total of 100.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a written exam or interview for the BBMB Lineman apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there will be no interview and no written exam.

faq.question: Q8. Do local residents get preference in the BBMB apprentice selection?
faq.answer: Yes. 25% of the seats for each trade will be given to holders of a residency certificate of the concerned districts of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. Any unfilled seats then go to State residents, and after that to open merit.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if I have already done an apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have done or are doing apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 in any other establishment should not apply.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the BBMB apprentice result be published?
faq.answer: The result of the apprentice engagement will be uploaded on the BBMB websites through the office of the System Software Manager, BBMB, Chandigarh.
